charge_port.notes: Toyota USA: the 2026 bZ has a newly standard NACS inlet (2027 bZ release: NACS port standard).

supercharger_access.notes: Toyota USA: 'More than 25,000 additional NACS charger plugs available to 2026 bZ drivers through the Tesla Supercharger Network'.
Toyota Canada: 'Toyota BEV drivers are now able to enjoy charging through the Tesla Supercharger Network'; 2026 BEVs have a NACS connector (Canada).

curb_weight_kg.notes: Converted from 4,464 lb (x0.45359 = 2,024.8): Canadian dealer page relaying Toyota Canada, Limited AWD. Fact-check: a search excerpt of the Toyota Canada sheet also shows 2024.84 (4464). The Car Guide page gives 2,065 kg (4,553 lb) and is treated as the outlier.

heat_pump.notes: Quick web lookup. Page lists "Heat pump system for both heating and air-conditioning" for the model without trim qualifier; recorded as standard. Page names no trims; trim coverage unconfirmed.

wheels.notes: Limited AWD: 20-inch black multi-spoke alloy wheels.
